reviews.t: I am very disappointed with this product
reviews.x: I am very disappointed with this product. I bought it in hopes of using it as a natural moisturizer for my face, as I have very sensitive skin and cannot have fragrance or any of that sorts in my face products. Looking on the website it says the only ingredient in this is "Aloe Vera". Upon arrive of this products I looked at the back side to look at the ingredients and fragrance is listed.

The product is advertised as being 100% Aloe Vera, but it’s not!  I was completely disturbed when I noticed the 2nd thing listed is alcohol which dries out anything.  There are a whole lot of other ingredients as well (some I cannot read because of the label attached).  This is false advertisement.  The entire back label should be visible & made known to the consumers online, prior to purchasing.
I’ve purchases many organic aloe Vera gel & this one definitely has added fragrance ingredients. It made me break out!

Initially bought this product because it claimed to be 100% Aloe Vera. After receiving the product, we immediately noticed the fragrance. We tried a small amount on our hand and it was very cool to the touch. It dissipates quickly into your skin and doesn’t feel like aloe but instead like hand sanitizer. I turned over to see the ingredients and, sure enough, this product is not 100% Aloe Vera. Given the fragrance and texture, I wouldn’t be surprised if it were hand sanitizer.
I keep it in the frig and use under puffy eyes! It helps better than any eye cream that I have used.

This product is a hand sanitizer with a false label and is not not pure 100% Aloe Vera as advertised. It also contains Alcohol as the second ingredient which dries the skin not moisturize it. Water is the first. If, the product is 100% Aleo Vera why is water added?  About 14 different ingredients in total. The Fragrance smells like hand sanitizer. It isn't suppose to have any Fragrance. ??  I had to rate it as one star. I couldn't give it the rating that I wanted too because there are no negativ

Please read ingredient before buying this is not just aloe vera it may not contain Benzophenone, Mineral Oil, Artificial Coloring or Paraben but it does have a lot of other ingredients; actually, over a dozen other products such as alcohol, preservatives, extracts, oils and an added fragrance (doesn't say what it is).  They have two aloe vera ingredients one in the middle and one at the end of ingredients.  This isn't a pure 100% aloe vera product.  Pure means nothing else is added. Even with th
I used this Aloe Vera since last year. I applied to my face every night and makes my face super smooth.

I love everything about this product. I have plaque psoriasis & must use aloe Vera on my scalp for 20 before shampooing. other aloe Vera products I’ve tried come in narrow top plastic bottles & it’s takes too long to squeeze out what I need. This one, as you can see, has a wide top/opening, very easy to apply with my fingers &  massage it into my scalp. It smells fresh & heavenly. I also have dry cracked heals & I simply rub a small amount on my heals each day before I put my socks on. I would r
This is NOT pure Aloe Vera. Gave me terrible itching. DO NOT BUY!!!!
NOT 100% ALOE VERA. Read the laber for additives!!!

Absolute garbage product. Not at all 100% aloe vera. Don’t be fooled by their misleading packaging like I was when I quickly scrolled through products and selected this one because it blatantly said 100% on the lid. They have all kinds of crap in here that is terrible for your skin.

I use this gel for DIY creams for my small business, I absolutely LOVE the fragrance, it gives all my creams a wonderful scent leaves the skin glowing and feeling fresh, it lightens up the skin and leaves it super soft the skin just eats it up

Love this stuff more than the banana boat and stuff we get at the stores here in the states. The gel is not sticky and feels so nice on my skin after I shave! I have really sensitive skin and I don't react to this at all.

It smells beautiful! I'm not someonewho really remembers to leave reviews, but this smells so good that I went out of my way to do so. My partner has me apply this daily for their scalp psoriasis and it has been helping.
I have developed rosacea and have had to change entire skin routine as everything irritates rosacea. This is a bit to watery making it difficult to apply to the face. More for sunburns I would think.
I am truly in ❤️❤️❤️ With this product . I’m using on my skin as moisturizer. I also use it as a Hair / Face mask . I would def purchase this product over / over again
Great product...my skin feels smooth and soft. I have used this product on my face, scars, and also after shaving. A must get item. Thank you.
Really smooth texture and the scent is amazing. I will buy again and recommend

reviews.t: Works really good. Just a bit to watery though
reviews.x: I use this to heal my scalp. Works really good. Just a bit to watery though.

reviews.t: Si buscas algo mas natural este no es el producto!!!!
reviews.x: Honestamente no se si en verdad sea 100% Aloe, por que tiene un olor a alcohol, esta en coreano asi que no pobria asegurar una cosa o la otra, lo que si tiene una consistencia como a gel para el cabello super ligera, tiene algo de fragancia, pero igual como tratamiento para mi cabello si le funcionó dejo mi cabello super brillante!!!!! Mi razon de mis pocas estrellas es precisamente por que yo estaba en busca de un producto hidratante 100% natural para cabello maltratado!!!!!

What I like about the product is that it's fresh and it's not harmful on the face especially having sensitive skin it makes me feel brand new. Extremely light on face including cools down my face when it is hot to go outside. It definitely also hydrating to the face!

This Aloe Vera is best I’ve had so far. It’s in an easy container and feels great on applications to my face. It absorbs rather quickly, so that’s a plus in my book. Lightly scented and very sheer which I sense helps the quicker absorption.

Very calming for irritated skin or acne. I keep mine in the fridge to keep cool and it feels so nice to slab some on before bed. I don't feel like it's as hydrating as I hoped for, but definitely something I'll always keep on hand

I love this product. It heals my skin overnight. And the burn on my hand I got from cooking is almost healed. The scent is great. I love the sheerness and thickness. I buy this all the time. I love that it’s all natural.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product is not 100% aloe vera as advertised, citing added ingredients such as alcohol, water, and fragrance.
Several reviewers report skin irritation, breakouts, or itching after using the product.
Some reviewers praise the product's fragrance and how it smells.
Several reviewers say the gel leaves their skin soft, smooth, and non-sticky, including for sensitive skin.
A few reviewers report positive results using it for scalp psoriasis or under-eye puffiness.
